content.short: Symbiotic is a permissionless restaking protocol that enables networks to bootstrap security using any ERC-20 asset.
content.description: Symbiotic is a decentralized restaking protocol designed to provide "security-as-a-service" for blockchain networks and Actively Validated Services. Its modular architecture allows any ERC-20 token to be used as collateral to secure decentralized infrastructure, enabling projects to choose their own custom assets, node operators, and slashing parameters. Operating on Ethereum, the platform focuses on high-throughput security coordination without intermediaries. Symbiotic serves as a foundational layer for oracles, bridges, and sidechains by leveraging existing capital for robust protection.
content.meta: Symbiotic provides a modular restaking protocol for bootstrapping decentralized network security with any ERC-20 asset. Discover Symbiotic on Lancers.
